messages.subject_clean: Running Maaslin on altered Centrifuge output files
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I'm attempting to run Maaslin (v0.0.5) in R (v3.4.4), using abundances calculated with Centrifuge. I believe I have formatted my files correctly so that Maaslin will read them, but I am getting the following error:

NAs introduced by coercionNAs introduced by coercionNAs introduced by coercionNAs introduced by coercion
Error in liItemElement[1]:liItemElement[2] : NA/NaN argument
My R command is as follows:
Maaslin('maaslin/gtdb_abundances/baseline/baseline_preAb_abundances_metadata_RCombined.txt', 'maaslin/gtdb_abundances/baseline/baseline_preAb_discrete_challengeSummary', strInputConfig='maaslin/gtdb_abundances/baseline/maaslin_config_baseline_preAb_challengeStatusSummary_RCombined_171218.config')
I've attached my config files and my abundance file (however just the first 1000 lines as the file is 50Mb and so can't be uploaded here), but as far as I can tell they are in the same format as the Maaslin ones? I initially had issues with non-allowed characters, but I have now removed all of those and the error persists.

Thanks,
Jane

messages.subject: Negative values?
messages.body_plain:
Hi everyone!

I am trying to use MaAsLin to analyze my data. While doing the analysis, I was wondering if my relative abundance data should not contain negative values to be able to perform the analysis with this program.

To give some background, we used an in vitro fermentation system and collected samples at different time points after the inoculation of the system. We are interested to see if there are microbial changes at 24 hours after the in vitro fermentation system was inoculated. So, I subtracted the data at 0hr (inoculation) from the data at 24hr (we called this "change scores"; 24hr-0hr) using the taxonomy relative abundance table. After doing this, I got a lot of negative numbers. Initially, I ran the MaAsLin and only got one taxa that significantly changes. But then I wondered if I would need to transform my data previous using MaAsLin. I want to be sure I am using the correct data input for this tool.

I would appreciate your feedback on this.

Thanks and best regards,

Ida
